title: Azzurra's Pro Tennis Challenge
subtitle: A doubles world tour in fourteen cities

authors.role: game design, programming, pixel art, music, documentation
authors.name: Claude Code (Anthropic)

acknowledgements: An original game: its players, cities, pictures, music and sounds were made for it. It reproduces no existing tennis game.
Every picture is drawn by the scripts in tools/ from simple shapes: the landmarks are well-known silhouettes, painted small. No photograph is traced or sampled.
Every sound is the PRG32 SID-like synthesizer playing an original score. No samples, no recordings.

The row compositor, the palette solver, the sequencer and the QEMU capture tool are adapted from The Trerrote Connection, You Have Got Pizza: Deluxe Edition and Drumfight Napoli 97 (PRG32 family, MIT).

controls.action: Drive / volley / smash; toss and serve
Aim: left / right, up deep, down short
Singles or doubles with up to four consoles, through the PRG32 Multiplayer Server
